title: Safehouse and Contact
author: Astrid Vane
blurb: Casper Yarrow, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
